result.stderr:
USAGE:
    scalver.dll [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    scalver.dll -m 1
    scalver.dll -m 2 -d YYYYMMDD
    scalver.dll -m 1 -p alpha -b

OPTIONS:
                                  DEFAULT                                       
    -h, --help                               Prints help information            
    -m, --major <NUMBER>                     Major version number (required,    
                                             bump manually for breaking changes)
    -d, --date-format <FORMAT>    YYYYMM     Date format for ScalVer: YYYY,     
                                             YYYYMM, or YYYYMMDD                
    -f, --folder <PATH>                      Repository-relative folder whose   
                                             commits determine the version      
    -p, --prerelease <ID>                    Prerelease identifier (e.g., alpha,
                                             beta, rc)                          
    -b, --buildmetadata                      Include build metadata (short SHA) 
                                             in the version                     
    -o, --output <FORMAT>         Text       Output format: text or json
